name: quad-pendulum-balance
$comment: Quadruple inverted pendulum on a cart: balance only, from a disturbed upright start (global th0_1..th0_4, deg) with a 50 ms tip push at 3 s. Plant: planar multibond bond graph (Prismatic2D rail, four Revolute2DCompliant joints with 1e8 N/m pivots, RigidBody2D cart and links), ideal force actuator with viscous rail friction and soft end stops. The firmware starts latched in the balance phase (balance_only).

options.text: **Balance only.** The chain starts near upright, leaning by the start angles below, and the 1 kHz LQR holds it. A tip push at 3 s (50 ms) tests the recovery. Change an input: then press **Run**. Try the actuator delay (1 ms steps), the quantised encoders, a heavier chain (the gains stay those of the nominal chain). **Controller:** *full travel* plans the swing-up with the whole rail; *short travel* keeps the cart within ±0.5 m (planned with that limit, same plant).
